claims.text: Overall Green Forest fire in Spain from 22 Jul 2026 00:00 UTC to 23 Jul 2026 00:00 UTC. Forest fire can have a low humanitarian impact based on the burned area and the affected population and their vulnerability. About 8,125 hectares burned and roughly 63 people in the affected area.

GDACS event report (eventid 1029643, episode 6): forest fire in Spain covering a 22-25 July 2026 window, citing about 21,999 hectares burned and roughly 3,667 people in the fire-affected area, assessed as low humanitarian impact based on burned area and affected population.

description: Multiple simultaneous wildfires broke out southwest of Madrid and in neighbouring Ávila province, Spain, on 22 July 2026 amid extreme heat and strong winds, prompting evacuations in towns including Villa del Prado, San Martín de Valdeiglesias, Pelayos de la Presa and Aldea del Fresno. GDACS's event report puts the burned area at about 22,000 hectares as of 25 July 2026, with roughly 3,667 people in the fire-affected area, and the fire remained active with continuing thermal-anomaly detections through today. Spain's Interior Ministry declared a national emergency for the fires on 23-24 July 2026 — widely reported as the first such declaration linked to a wildfire — and evacuation figures above 10,000 people have been widely reported; neither the national-emergency declaration nor the evacuation count has yet been confirmed by an allowlisted authoritative source.

impact.summary: GDACS's event report (eventid 1029643, episode 6) assessed a Green alert for low humanitarian impact for a forest fire in Spain covering 22-25 July 2026, citing about 21,999 hectares burned and roughly 3,667 people in the fire-affected area, with the most recent thermal-anomaly detection on 25 July 2026 — up sharply from 8,125 hectares/63 people affected when the event was first opened on 22-23 July. No allowlisted authoritative source has yet published a confirmed death toll or official evacuation count for this fire; Spain's widely reported national emergency declaration (23-24 July) and evacuation figures above 10,000 people come from non-allowlisted media and have not been independently confirmed here.

location.region: Southwestern Madrid region and Ávila province (Villa del Prado, San Martín de Valdeiglesias, Pelayos de la Presa, Aldea del Fresno)

name: Wildfires — Madrid & Ávila, Spain
